This prototype demonstrates a privacy-conscious referral landing page that a physician, school counselor, therapist, community organization, or other referral partner could share by link or QR code.

Referral source

Track the source, not the client.

The link can carry a non-sensitive source code such as ?ref=st-lukes-card-a. Analytics can record that the referral channel generated a visit without collecting the visitor’s name, diagnosis, reason for treatment, or other clinical details.
